scope: One fresh controlled disposable mailbox completed rendered email registration, mailbox verification, credential sign-in and workbench navigation in a Chrome extension-controlled browser on current private Version 18. One bounded non-sensitive early-riser habit attempt then showed the client network/login guidance without a visible check-in. A direct desktop-interface replay was not completed because the local desktop interaction surface was unavailable. The temporary account was requested for deletion, confirmed for deletion, refreshed into an unauthenticated state, and its temporary mailbox was deleted. No email address, password, verification link, recovery token, browser cookie, storage value, mailbox body, or business record was retained.

interpretation.proven: The current private Version 18 completed a rendered email registration, verification, credential login and account-deletion lifecycle in the Chrome extension-controlled surface. The same surface reduced a bounded non-sensitive habit POST to the client fetch-exception guidance with no visible record. The successful account deletion POST means this observation is not evidence that the verified account could not execute every authenticated mutation.
not_proven: A normal end-user browser outside the agent-controlled Chrome extension completed or failed a workbench mutation
A Worker, D1, R2, or Better Auth production defect
Successful ordinary-browser habit creation, history readback, or physical second-device synchronization
Public launch eligibility or final product acceptance
interpretation.decision: Do not weaken authentication, duplicate or rename workbench APIs, relax same-origin protections, or alter the frozen visual baseline merely to bypass this agent-controlled browser transport boundary. The still-required ordinary-browser replay must use a browser surface outside this guard.
